_curation.note: Hand-curated. `id` is the stable Claude Code request value (model_selection = alias). label/description/ratings written by a human from the current lineup. claude-agent-acp 0.109.0 (Claude Code 2.1.328) lists the tier aliases `default`, `opus`, `fable`, `sonnet` and `haiku` for both an API key and a subscription login, so the catalog publishes those. `fable` resolves to Claude Fable 5.2 and `haiku` to Claude Haiku 5.5; neither session lists `claude-fable-5-2` or `claude-haiku-5-5` as a value. Current lineup: Claude Fable 5.2 is the frontier, Claude Opus 5.5 is the recommended default one tier below it, then Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5. Ratings: 1-5, higher is better; `cost` is cost-efficiency (5 = cheapest).
_curation.sources: @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp@0.109.0 session/new model config options (API key and subscription login, probed 2026-11-20); Anthropic models overview, Fable 5.2 overview and pricing pages, checked 2026-11-20.
